description: OFFLINE FICTIONAL INVENTORY ONLY. Ready states, UIDs, node names, hostnames, VG names and free capacities are examples, not evidence of real initialization. two-node-shared-disk-lab requires the same two pools for ZooKeeper/journal/ledger and >=94Gi actual free space per pool. One data disk per node provides no physical role isolation, no host-failure HA, and cannot run the original three-node E2E. Never apply a manifest generated from this fixture to the real cluster.
